project_type: OMK (oh-my-kiro) framework - bash hooks + Python scripts + Markdown skills/commands/agents/templates/docs. The previous EN->PT-BR translation pass has been merged to main; this pass translates the remaining Chinese (Mandarin) passages to Brazilian Portuguese.
build_system: No build step. Python uses pip; Markdown is consumed by hooks/skills directly.
test_framework: pytest (Python unit tests under tests/) + custom bash test scripts under tests/**/*.sh and tests/knowledge/run.sh.
test_command: python3 -m pytest -q --ignore=tests/test_generate_configs.py --ignore=tests/test_debugging_skill.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_evaluator.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_pty_runner.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_ralph_loop.py  &&  bash tests/test-agents-template.sh  &&  bash tests/knowledge/run.sh
verification_instructions: 1) After every batch run: `git diff --stat <previous-sha>` should show only .md files; YAML front-matter, fenced code blocks, links, paths, and the 9 test-anchored English literals must remain identical at the byte level. 2) Run pytest with the documented ignore set and confirm pass count is unchanged from baseline (60 passed / 8 pre-existing failures). 3) Run `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh` and confirm 27 passed / 1 failed (pre-existing 'OMK SECTIONS' mismatch on coding.md). 4) Run `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh` and confirm 1 pass / 3 total scripts (l1-rules-injection + l1-corruption-recall pre-existing failures). 5) After the LAST batch, run: `find . -name '*.md' -not -path './tests/knowledge/fixtures/*' -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.agents/*' -not -path './.pytest_cache/*' -exec grep -l -P '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' {} \;` and confirm the result is EMPTY (no remaining CJK outside fixtures). 6) Spot-check 3 translated files for: front-matter intact, fenced code blocks intact, technical terms preserved, no em dashes added.
snapshot_or_generated_files: knowledge/.health-report.md is auto-regenerated by hooks/feedback/kb-health-report.sh on the next hook run; it does not currently contain CJK so this pass should not touch it. docs/plans/*.progress.md and docs/plans/*.findings.md are human-written iteration logs; translate the prose, keep timestamps/paths/hashes verbatim.
setup_instructions: 1) Working directory is /projects/sandbox/oh-my-kiro. 2) `git -C /projects/sandbox/oh-my-kiro status` must be clean on `main` (already true). 3) python3 + pytest already installed in this sandbox. 4) Create the working branch: `git checkout -b feat/translate-cn-to-ptbr` from current main HEAD before any edits.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET sandbox. Python 3.9 installed; pytest installed. Pre-existing-broken pytest suites listed in --ignore set above (Python 3.10+ syntax in scripts/generate_configs.py + scripts/lib/, renamed skill path in skills/omk-debugging, OpenViking sockets unavailable, hook env unavailable). These failures EXIST ON main BEFORE this translation pass. tests/test-agents-template.sh = 27/1 pre-existing fail. tests/knowledge/run.sh = 1 pass / 3 total (l1-rules-injection + l1-corruption-recall pre-existing failures from context-enrichment.sh dedup). Translation must NOT regress these counts.
contribution_requirements: Per task spec: in-place translation of CHINESE -> PT-BR only. ALL rules from .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/translation-rules.md continue to apply (front-matter byte-identical, fenced code blocks verbatim, inline code/URLs/paths/CLI commands/identifiers verbatim, English test-anchored literals untouched, English consecrated tech terms left in English, technical acronyms in English, product/tool names in English, no em dashes, 'voce' informal). Files in tests/knowledge/fixtures/ are NEVER modified. For mixed CN+EN files where the EN half was already translated to PT-BR (most files in this repo on main), translate ONLY the Chinese passages in this pass; do NOT re-translate or alter existing PT-BR text unless adjacent CN content is being merged into a sentence. For lines that mix EN keywords with CN narrative (e.g. headings like `## Workflow - 复杂任务先 interview`), translate the Chinese tail to PT-BR while keeping the English keywords as-is per the consecrated-term and product-name rules.
key_patterns: 1) The previous translation contract is documented at .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/translation-rules.md. Read it once at the start of every batch. 2) 9 test-anchored English literals MUST remain unchanged: `Coding agent`, `GTM`, `Evidence before claims`, `Skill Routing`, `Authority Matrix`, `episodes.md`, `BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES`, `**Verdict: APPROVE**`, `**Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**`. The HTML region markers `<!-- BEGIN OMK ... -->` / `<!-- END OMK ... -->` in templates/agents-sections/*.md are byte-identical anchors. 3) YAML `description:` value of every skill/command file is matched at runtime by hooks/feedback/context-enrichment.sh against user prompts, so YAML front-matter values must remain byte-identical. The Chinese trigger examples that appear in description: values (e.g. '改代码', '修复', '加个', '改一下', '优化', '生成 PDF', '导出 PDF', '做个 PDF', '设计稿', '设计.*代码', '视觉.*对比') are pattern-matched literals - DO NOT translate them. 4) Body content (after the front-matter `---` closing line) is translatable: ## Trigger Examples lists, headings, prose, table cells, blockquotes. Chinese inside fenced code blocks (```...```) and inline code (`...`) is verbatim. 5) Files like AGENTS.md and templates/agents-sections/*.md mix English headings (`## Principles`, `## Workflow`, `## Authority Matrix`) with Chinese bullets - keep the English headings as-is per rule 8 (technical terms in headings stay in English) and translate the Chinese bullets to PT-BR. 6) `.kiro/rules/code-analysis.md` and `knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-{02,03}.md` are pure-Chinese files - translate prose to PT-BR, keep all technical identifiers (LSP tools names, function names, file paths, hook names) in their original form. 7) docs/designs/2026-02-13-framework-v2-upgrade.md is the largest file (853 CJK lines, 2347 total lines) - translate in chunks, watch out for headings that mix Chinese with English keywords (`## Part 0: 调研总结 - 官方最佳实践要点` -> `## Part 0: Resumo da pesquisa - principais práticas oficiais`). 8) Knowledge episodes (knowledge/episodes.md, knowledge/rules.md, knowledge/archive/episodes-2026-*.md) follow a `DATE | STATUS | KEYWORDS | SUMMARY` pipe-delimited format. The KEYWORDS column is comma-separated tokens (often English technical) - keep verbatim. The SUMMARY column is Chinese prose - translate. The STATUS column values (`active`, `resolved`, `promoted`) are English literals - keep verbatim. 9) Inside Chinese prose, bracketed Chinese in parentheses like `(测试驱动开发)` is a gloss for an English term that precedes it - just translate the gloss to PT-BR (`(desenvolvimento orientado a testes)`).
relevant_files: tests/knowledge/fixtures/*.md (DO NOT TRANSLATE - asserted byte-exactly by tests/knowledge/l1-*.sh)
directory_structure: Same as previous pass - see .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/context.json. agents/=subagent prompts; commands/=user-triggered command markdowns; docs/={INDEX,EXTENSION-GUIDE,e2e-report*}.md+designs/+plans/+releases/=user-facing docs; knowledge/=runtime knowledge base (episodes, rules, archive, reference, INDEX); skills/=skill definitions; templates/=scaffolding copied by tools/init-project.sh; tests/knowledge/fixtures/=test fixtures (do NOT touch); .kiro/rules/=steering rules read by Kiro at runtime.
